intent: Redesign existing objects with recognizable functional parts and natural proportions

assets.name: 便携空气循环机
assets.prompt: Project asset for an original cyberpunk second-hand shop game. Generate a single isolated object on genuine transparent background, detailed painterly 2.5D game prop, neutral front three-quarter view with very little perspective foreshortening, worn believable metal and plastic, restrained warm edge light and tiny cyan indicators. Clear functional silhouette legible at 30 to 90 pixels. Entire object visible. No words, logos, label text, UI, grid, pedestal, cast shadow, collage or extra objects. Preserve natural real object proportions. The reference is the old object to redesign; retain its subject and worn grounded visual family but replace the form as specified. Do not stretch the old image. Redesign as a naturally tall narrow portable air purifier / air circulator tower, height about twice width. Two visibly round fan grilles stacked vertically in an ivory metal housing, replaceable dark filter grille at the bottom, compact strong carry handle above, teal side latches. The two round fans must remain circular, not oval. A practical heavy street workshop appliance, no science fiction weapon parts.
